erc.fp: pin_to_pin | Symbol U105 Pin 4 [Tri-state, Line] || Symbol U5 Pin 7 [SO, Output, Line]
erc.why: SPI_MISO is a shared bus by design: U105 (74LVC1G125) only drives it while the ESP chip select is low, Croco's U5 only while its own CS is low (netlist U105 note)
+BATT power symbol of the removed (DNP) coin-cell holder BT1: the net now only holds BT1's own pin; kept so the holder can be restored by flipping its DNP flag (LOGBOOK 09:10)

drc.fp: solder_mask_bridge | Pad 2 [GB_CLK] of J5 on F.Cu || Polygon of J5 on F.Mask
drc.why: Croco's J5 edge-connector footprint: one common mask opening over all gold fingers, by design. Same item class is in the baseline; KiCad reports at most 199 per type, so which J5 fingers get listed shifts when other mask items change
